endorsements.label: Pwn2Own Vancouver 2024 - Day Two Results
endorsements.description: Edouard Bochin ( @le_douds ) and Tao Yan ( @Ga1ois ) from Palo Alto Networks used an OOB Read plus a novel technique for defeating V8 hardening to get arbitrary code execution in the renderer. They were able to exploit Chrome and Edge with the same bugs, earning $42,500 and 9 Master of Pwn points.
